card.name: ACP Bounty (Poll + Match Lifecycle)
card.description: Poll ACP bounty lifecycle: discover candidates, track claimed jobs, and surface deliverables. Intended for a Pod loop that keeps state and notifies a user.

notes: This is primarily read-only, but it can advance local lifecycle state. Still treat as sensitive output (may contain candidate info).
Recommended: record receipts for key transitions (candidate selected, job created, job completed, settlement).
